en.headline: Police arrest 269 in tech-scam crackdown; phone-scam losses hit HK$900m in H1
en.dek: A two-week operation netted 269 people linked to 203 cases with HK$320 million in losses; overall deception cases fell slightly but phone and phishing fraud rose sharply.
body: Hong Kong police said they arrested 269 people over the past two weeks in connection with 203 technology-related scam cases that involved total losses of about HK$320 million. The cases mainly involved phone scams, online shopping fraud and investment fraud. Officers intercepted HK$2.5 million of the stolen funds.

Superintendent Kwok Ching-yee of the Commercial Crime Bureau said the force recorded 20,613 deception cases in the first half of 2026, a slight drop of 0.7 per cent from a year earlier. Total losses fell 0.8 per cent to HK$3.51 billion. Phone scams, however, rose 45 per cent to 4,830 cases and generated losses of HK$900 million, up 56 per cent. Phishing cases rose 61 per cent to 1,113.

Kwok said impersonating customer-service staff was the most common phone-scam tactic, accounting for nearly half of such cases. One victim lost nearly HK$4 million after fraudsters posing as Alipay customer service claimed an unwanted insurance purchase and directed the victim through a phishing link to make repeated bank transfers. Scammers also frequently pose as staff from courier companies.

As part of the same period of operations, police dismantled a syndicate that used AI-altered images of lost or stolen Hong Kong identity cards to open bank accounts for money laundering. Fifteen people were arrested in that strand of the investigation. The force urged the public never to share selfie photographs that could be used for facial-verification abuse and to hang up and verify any unexpected customer-service call through official apps.

zh.headline: 警方兩周拘269人打科技騙案 上半年電話騙案損失9億
zh.dek: 行動涉及203宗案件、損失約3.2億元；整體詐騙案微跌，但電話及釣魚騙案分別升45%及61%。
body: 警方表示，過去兩周拘捕269人，涉及203宗科技相關騙案，總損失約3.2億元。案件主要為電話騙案、網上購物及網上投資詐騙，警方成功截獲250萬元贓款。
商業罪案調查科總警司郭靜怡指，今年上半年錄得20,613宗詐騙案，按年微跌0.7%，總損失35.1億元，跌0.8%。惟電話騙案升45%至4,830宗，損失達9億元，升56%；釣魚騙案升61%至1,113宗。
郭靜怡表示，假冒客戶服務是電話騙案最常見手法，佔近半數。一名受害人被假冒支付寶客服以「誤買保險」為由，透過釣魚連結指示多次轉帳，最終損失近400萬元。騙徒亦常假冒速遞公司職員。
同期行動亦搗破一個利用AI改圖偽造香港身份證影像、於銀行及儲值支付工具開戶洗黑錢的集團，共拘捕15人。警方呼籲市民切勿將自拍照片交予他人作人臉識別，遇可疑客服來電應先掛線，再透過官方應用程式核實。
